data.exact_reserve_text: As a result of these changes, $64.7m of reserves were released in the period (on a net of reinsurance basis).
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported a net release of $64.7 million in reserves for prior periods in 2023. This favorable development was primarily driven by a refinement in the managing agent's methodology for estimating claims reserves, which included revisions to the actuarial methodology for determining the risk margin and updates to the calculation of future claims handling expenses. The 2022 underwriting year, despite experiencing more natural catastrophes, is projected to close with a positive return on capacity, indicating favorable development for that prior year.

revising the actuarial methodology behind determining the risk margin
updating the calculation methodology behind the provision for future claims handling expenses
